paragraphs: JusticeONE sells a cloud-based Public Safety & Justice Platform that connects law enforcement, courts, payments, schools, airports, transit authorities and security organizations. Platform components listed include records management, dispatch, mobile RMS, eCitation, NCIC, municipal court software, and payment processing.

The company states that it has developed software for law enforcement agencies, municipal courts, and public safety organizations since 1997. Named markets on the site include law enforcement, courts, city finance, schools, private security, parking enforcement, airports, and transit authorities.

Product pages cover municipal court and payment software, law enforcement and public safety software, and public safety software for schools and universities. Other sections describe software for police departments and sheriff offices, transit authorities, and airport police and parking enforcement. One customer is named in a testimonial on the home page, Buford City Schools, GA.

quote.text: JusticeONE connects law enforcement, courts, payments, schools, airports, transit authorities and security organizations through one cloud-based Public Safety & Justice Platform.
